text:
emma: hi team, day 2 here. two quick issues before standup:
emma: 1) second monitor not detected when connected to dock via HDMI -> monitor stays on 'No Signal'. laptop sees only internal display. opened ticket TKT-22890.
emma: 2) Wi-Fi seems extremely slow on Corp-WiFi (pages time out, downloads <100kbps) but guest network is fine.
dylan-onboarding: welcome emma! :wave: tagging IT and ops. did the monitor come with DP cable or HDMI?
emma: monitor box had HDMI but the dock has a miniDP out. the kit included a miniDP->HDMI adapter. i plugged that in and still nothing.
kevin-it: hey emma, welcome. quick checks: 1) System Settings > Displays — does it show a second display detected at all? 2) try the monitor directly to laptop with the same adapter to rule out dock port. 3) screenshot of Displays prefs helps.
emma: Displays prefs only shows built-in. when i plug adapter directly to laptop still nothing. monitor model is ViewSonic VX2476. power LED is solid.
kevin-it: try a different HDMI cable if possible; some adapters are finicky. also check monitor input selector (some auto-switch but try manual HDMI). SOP: reseat all cables, power cycle monitor.
sophie-ops: we have spare miniDP->HDMI and DP->HDMI adapters in Locker 7 (code 6612). emma want me to leave one there?
emma: yes please leave one, i'll grab it after standup. thanks sophie.
kevin-it: about Wi-Fi: can you run `ping 8.8.8.8 -n 20` (windows) or `ping -c 20 8.8.8.8` (mac/linux) and paste average latency? also check IP (DHCP) and signal strength.
emma: ping shows packet loss ~40% and avg latency 180ms. IP is 10.50.22.19. signal shown as -62 dBm.
kevin-it: high latency and loss at -62 could be interference. try moving closer to the AP or switch to 5GHz SSID (Redwood-5G) if available. also forget and re-add the network. i'll also check AP-side whether there's congestion on that channel.
kevin-it: created internal ticket NET-4987 to check AP load for your building floor and channel. in parallel, try connecting laptop to dock via Ethernet (or use USB-C dongle) to confirm whether it's wireless-only.
emma: grabbed adapter from locker, swapped it in, monitor detected immediately. thanks ops! display now extends.
emma: also tried switching to Redwood-5G and signal/latency much better: ping avg 12ms, no loss. happy to use 5G for now.
kevin-it: awesome. i updated TKT-22890: resolution = faulty adapter replaced from locker. NET-4987 assigned to wireless team to review AP channel/congestion; interim fix advised: prefer Redwood-5G or wired if possible.
dylan-onboarding: welcome again emma! let us know if you want a quick desk tour or repo access.
emma: all set, closing from my side. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
